model: OpenAI Codex; exact runtime model name not exposed to worker
notice: Engineering profile only. No legal or readiness determination.

implementation_details.notice: Retrieval leads only; no identity, legal effect, status, original-authentication or completeness determination.

coverage.scope: Exactly held_texts(): sorted jobs/*/output/texts recursive *.txt, excluding clause-drafts; no acquisition or legal completeness claim.

corpus.integrity_notice: Cache digest detects accidental corruption. All source bytes are hashed before and after matching; concurrent changes observed in either pass cause refusal.

implementation_details.timing_scope: Retrieval and verification before output serialization/writes; outer process wall time includes output.
implementation_details.offsets: Zero-based, half-open Unicode character offsets in UTF-8 replacement-decoded universal-newline source text. Raw-byte SHA256 binds the held file; offsets are not raw-byte offsets.
